decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west flanks of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 5 - At the start of work on site, the existing decorative terracotta roof ridge tiles shall be removed and stored and shall be replaced in the same location as part of completion of the development before it is first occupied.  Any tiles that break or become damaged shall be replaced with matching tiles
description: Erection of a rear roof extension and installation of 2 x front roof lights to the house.
